# Hilarius Design

> Hilarius Design creates original corporate gifts, giveaways, packaging and
> objects made from recycled board (cardboard). Founded and run by designer
> Wim Hilarius, with over forty years of experience turning recycled paper and
> board into smart, durable, fully customizable products. Based in Koog aan de
> Zaan, the Netherlands; delivering across the Netherlands and Europe.

## What Hilarius Design makes

- Corporate gifts and giveaways in recycled board, printed in your corporate identity.
- Premium packaging, tubes and retail displays.
- Cardboard transport models (trucks, cars, aircraft, trains) used as gift packaging.
- Board games, puzzles and promotional games.
- Desk accessories such as calendars and clocks.
- Sample books, folders and booklets.
- Interior and exterior displays, scale models and spatial presentations.
- Festive year-end gifts.

Every product is designed and produced in-house, from first sketch to delivery,
and can be fully tailored to a client's brand. The core material is recycled
board: light, strong, sustainable and endlessly printable.

## Categories

- [Transport](https://www.hilariusdesign.nl/en/category/transport) — cardboard trucks, cars, aircraft and trains.
- [Desk accessories](https://www.hilariusdesign.nl/en/category/bureau-accessoires) — desk calendars, (wall) clocks and more.
- [Packaging](https://www.hilariusdesign.nl/en/category/verpakkingen) — premium packaging, tubes and displays.
- [Books & Folders](https://www.hilariusdesign.nl/en/category/boeken-mappen) — sample books, folders and booklets.
- [Games](https://www.hilariusdesign.nl/en/category/spellen) — board games, throwing games and puzzles.
- [The Art Of Board](https://www.hilariusdesign.nl/en/category/the-art-of-board) — ideas made of board.
- [Interior & Exterior](https://www.hilariusdesign.nl/en/category/interieur-exterieur) — displays, scale models and spatial presentations.
- [Year-end Gifts](https://www.hilariusdesign.nl/en/category/eindejaarsgeschenken) — festive products for the end of the year.
